subject: Maths
title: Finding the Furry Cat!
intro: This chapter, Finding the Furry Cat!, covers Inside and Outside, On and Under, Above and Below, Top, Middle and Bottom and more. Read the short notes first, check every NCERT answer, practise the important questions and then attempt the 30-mark sample paper. All four PDFs are free to download.
topics: A thing is INSIDE when it is within the edges of a space (bag, basket, car, room) and OUTSIDE when it is not.
ON means resting on the top of a thing and touching it; UNDER means lower than a thing, with that thing over it.
ABOVE means higher than another thing and BELOW means lower than it; they compare TWO things, and touching is not needed.
TOP, MIDDLE and BOTTOM name the highest part, the centre and the lowest part of ONE thing.
NEAR means close to a thing and FAR means a long way from it; we join position words to tell exactly where something is.
In a line, things in front of a thing come BEFORE it and things behind it come AFTER it.
We SORT things by putting the things that are alike in some way (kind, colour, shape) into one group.

items: Inside = within the edges of a space (bag, basket, car, room). Outside = not within the space.
Inside and outside are opposites. First find the space, then see where the thing is.
Works for any space: a room, a car, a cave, a dustbin.
On = resting on the top of a thing and touching it.
Under = lower than a thing, with that thing over it.
The ball under the bed is not inside the bed. The cat on the car is not under it.
Above = higher than another thing. Below = lower than it.
They compare TWO things and the things need not touch.
If the cat is above the hat, then the hat is below the cat.
Top, middle and bottom name the parts of ONE thing: the highest part, the centre, the lowest part.
Ask: is it within the edges? Yes = inside, No = outside.
Look at the top: on the top = ON. Covered from above = UNDER.
Above is not the same as on: a fan is above the table but does not touch it.

sol_items: Let us Sing (page 3): encircle the correct word: under
B. The cat is inside / outside / on the car.: on
C. The man is lying under / inside / on the tree.: under
D. The cow is inside / top of / outside the house.: outside
B. Where do you throw the garbage? Inside / Outside the dustbin.: Inside the dustbin
imp_items: Where does the paper go when you throw it away: inside or outside the dustbin?
Draw a cloud above a house and a mat below the door.
the cloud is higher than the house; the mat is lower than the door
A traffic light has red, yellow and green from the top. Which colour is in the middle?
